title: Hello makes more room for the community
summary:
Veo gained first-to-last-frame video, the MCP server picked up a toolbox, and Hello gave community projects and contributors more room.

Hello now sends generation requests directly to the unified API, retries rate-limited requests, and adds a dreams theme. Its Community page highlights contributors from the past year, while refreshed tier and app pages make submissions easier to find. The submission workflow now checks Enter registration, accepts fewer required fields, and grants Flower tier when an eligible, labeled contribution is merged. AI Chat Studio also joined the project directory.

Veo video requests can take first and last frame URLs, giving creators control over both ends of a generated clip. Z-Image Turbo now generates at the requested resolution rather than generating smaller images and upscaling them, with dimensions still capped at 2048.

MCP server v2 routes generation through the unified API and adds tools for video, parallel image generation, image description, video analysis, transcription, web search, tool-calling chat, and model pricing. It now uses API keys, fetches model lists from the API, and requires Node.js 18 or newer.

highlights.title: Steer both ends of a video
highlights.text: Give Veo a first frame and a last frame by passing two URLs in `image`, separated by a pipe or comma. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: More tools for MCP
highlights.text: The MCP server now supports video generation, parallel images, image description, video analysis, transcription, web search, and tool-calling chat. [Explore the MCP docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).

highlights.title: Meet the contributors
highlights.text: Hello's Community page now features a tribute to GitHub contributors from the past year, with links to their profiles. [Visit the community](https://pollinations.ai).
